title: Jeremiah Buys a Field During the Siege

questions.question: In the tenth year of Zedekiah, while the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, where was Jeremiah confined?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:2 (ESV): "At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard that was in the palace of the king of Judah."

questions.question: Who did King Zedekiah shut Jeremiah up for prophesying that the city would be given into the hand of the king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:3 (ESV): "For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, 'Why do you prophesy and say, “Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon...”'"

questions.question: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah saying that Hanamel the son of Shallum his uncle would come to him and ask him to buy what?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:7 (ESV): "Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you and say, 'Buy my field that is at Anathoth, for the right of redemption by purchase is yours.'"

questions.question: How much did Jeremiah weigh out to pay for the field?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:9 (ESV): "and I weighed out the money to him, seventeen shekels of silver."

questions.question: What did Jeremiah do to make the transaction legal and secure?
options: Signed the deed, sealed it, got witnesses, and weighed the money on scales
Swore an oath before the king
Buried the silver in the field
questions.correctAnswer: Signed the deed, sealed it, got witnesses, and weighed the money on scales
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:10 (ESV): "I signed the deed, sealed it, got witnesses, and weighed the money on scales."

questions.question: To whom did Jeremiah give the deeds of purchase in the presence of witnesses?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:12 (ESV): "and I gave the deed of purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah son of Mahseiah,"

questions.question: Where did Jeremiah tell Baruch to put the deeds so that they might last for a long time?
options: Under the floor of the guardhouse
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:14 (ESV): "Take these deeds, both this sealed deed of purchase and this open deed, and put them in an earthenware vessel, that they may last for a long time."

questions.question: Why did the Lord tell Jeremiah to buy the field, even though the city was about to fall?
options: "Houses and fields and vineyards shall again be bought in this land."
"The Babylonians will spare those who own land."
"To have a grave to be buried in."
questions.correctAnswer: "Houses and fields and vineyards shall again be bought in this land."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:15 (ESV): "For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Houses and fields and vineyards shall again be bought in this land."

questions.question: In Jeremiah's prayer to the Lord after buying the field, he begins by praising God: "Ah, Lord God! It is you who have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm! Nothing is too... for you."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:17 (ESV): "Nothing is too hard for you."

questions.question: "You show steadfast love to thousands, but you repay the guilt of fathers to their children after them, O great and mighty God, whose name is the..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:18 (ESV): "O great and mighty God, whose name is the Lord of hosts,"

questions.question: The Lord answered Jeremiah: "Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is anything too... for me?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:27 (ESV): "Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is anything too hard for me?"

questions.question: The Lord explains why the city is being given to the Chaldeans: "Because the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done nothing but... in my sight from their youth;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:30 (ESV): "For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done nothing but evil in my sight from their youth;"

questions.question: "They have turned to me their... and not their face. And though I have taught them persistently, they have not listened to receive instruction."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:33 (ESV): "They have turned to me their back and not their face."

questions.question: "And I will make with them an... covenant, that I will not turn away from doing good to them. And I will put the fear of me in their hearts, that they may not turn from me."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:40 (ESV): "I will make with them an everlasting covenant, that I will not turn away from doing good to them."

questions.question: "I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will plant them in this land in faithfulness, with all my... and all my..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:41 (ESV): "with all my heart and all my soul."

key_verse_text: "Ah, Lord God! It is you who have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm! Nothing is too hard for you."
